anchor: The planner sizes replicas as ceil(d_hat / r_hat) where r_hat is its belief about per-replica throughput (measured in-loop: median 10.07 req/s per TP2 replica); the SLA-relevant capacity is instead the measured tail knee r_tail, the largest offered rate a replica sustains under the tail SLA (1.62 req/s on burst1's mix; [1.26, 1.44] on burst4, the binding mix).
claim_text: Planner uses r_hat=10.07 req/s (median); tail knee r_tail=1.62 req/s (burst1) and 1.26-1.44 req/s (burst4).

adjudication.observed: belief_rps=10.07 (from 86 ticks); burst1 r_tail_rps=1.6233047244281011 (method: measured); burst4 bounds are [1.25875, 1.4385714285714286] (method: bracketed)
adjudication.evidence: In provenance.capacity_derivation, belief_rps is exactly 10.07. For burst1, r_tail_rps is 1.6233 (rounds to 1.62). For burst4, r_tail is bracketed between r_tail_lo_rps=1.25875 and r_tail_hi_rps=1.43857 (rounds to [1.26, 1.44]).
adjudication.query: SELECT window_name, belief_rps, r_tail_rps, r_tail_lo_rps, r_tail_hi_rps, r_tail_method FROM provenance.capacity_derivation;

adjudication.observed: The median is 10.07 over 86 nondegenerate ticks. For burst1, the largest tested passing offered rate is 1.6233047244281011 req/s per replica, while 2.1643370639993678 fails. Burst4 has no offered-rate probes: forecast-scale probes pass at implied capacities 1.25875 and 1.4385714285714286 and fail at 1.6189710610932477.
adjudication.evidence: All selected rows are current and nonsuperseded; the belief and burst1 value are supported, but burst4's values are implied forecast-scale capacities, not a measured offered-rate knee or knee bracket.
adjudication.fix: Retain the 10.07 median and describe burst1 as the largest tested passing offered rate; replace the burst4 knee claim with: forecast-scale probes passed at implied capacities 1.25875 and 1.4385714285714286 req/s and failed at 1.6189710610932477 req/s, so no direct burst4 offered-rate knee was measured.
adjudication.query: WITH belief AS (SELECT run_id, COUNT(*) AS nondegenerate_ticks, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY engine_rps) AS median_engine_rps FROM provenance.capacity_belief_sample WHERE run_id = 'riders:fc_lead60' AND NOT is_degenerate GROUP BY run_id), probes AS (SELECT k.probe_id, k.window_name, k.probe_kind, k.arrival_speedup, k.forecast_req_scale, k.offered_rps_per_replica, k.implied_r_tail, k.p99_ttft_ms, k.p99_itl_ms, k.sla_ttft_p99_ms, k.sla_itl_p99_ms, k.passes, k.is_superseded, d.is_current, d.superseded_by, d.tp, d.n_replicas, p.n_requests FROM provenance.capacity_knee_probe k JOIN provenance.v_dim d ON d.run_id = k.run_id AND d.window_name = k.window_name JOIN provenance.v_pool_latency p ON p.run_id = k.run_id AND p.window_name = k.window_name AND p.sla_metric = 'ttft' WHERE d.is_current AND NOT k.is_superseded) SELECT b.nondegenerate_ticks, b.median_engine_rps, p.window_name, p.probe_id, p.probe_kind, p.arrival_speedup, p.forecast_req_scale, p.offered_rps_per_replica, p.implied_r_tail, p.p99_ttft_ms, p.p99_itl_ms, p.sla_ttft_p99_ms, p.sla_itl_p99_ms, p.passes, p.is_current, p.is_superseded, p.superseded_by, p.tp, p.n_replicas, p.n_requests FROM belief b CROSS JOIN probes p ORDER BY p.window_name, p.probe_kind, COALESCE(p.arrival_speedup, p.forecast_req_scale)
